voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is before noon, when the garden is cool and calm. Entry is paid. The mansion was closed for restoration for a while, so check before you go. Local tip: on the way back, go up to Boztepe hill and end the day with the widest view of the city. Your next stop is Hagia Sophia Mosque, about five kilometres by car, around fifteen minutes.
